genxml.title: Rendering engine register window
genxml.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 for Windows NT 4.0, kernel driver and display driver code, with the type declarations in the driver's program database
genxml.doc: The registers of the rendering engine window that the Windows NT 4.0 kernel driver reads or writes directly, and the 32-bit payload words of the packets the drivers send. The window is the range the driver maps; offsets below are from its base. Access records what the drivers do to the register at its own address, directly: a register that only a packet writes shows the direct accesses only (the scissor pair is "r" for that reason). Nothing here is a reset value, and no register is read before it is written.

struct.name: TLB_ENTRY
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, hardware start-up and the translation-table packets
struct.doc: Translation table: one entry per tile of the buffers the engine addresses. A tile is 1, 4, 16, 64 or 256 pages of 4 KB, as the buffer's descriptor says; the packet pool is 16 tiles of 256 pages, so it fills 16 entries. Only the low dword is ever written, with the tile's first 4 KB page frame number masked to 24 bits; entries not in use hold the first entry's value. The packet pool, the display buffers and the textures are named through these entries, so the engine fetches packets through this table rather than by physical address.

struct.name: TLB_DESC
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, hardware start-up and the translation-table packets; type CoTlbDescReg in the OpenGL driver's program database
struct.doc: Buffer descriptor table: entry k describes the buffer whose descriptor id is k, the six-bit id the colour-format, depth-format and texture-format words carry. Entry 0 is the packet pool. The low dword only is written. A tiled buffer is a run of tiles of 128 or 512 bytes in a row, with tiles_per_row tiles per row, whose pages start at the translation-table slot in offset; a pinned host buffer (flat) sets only bit 19 with the page-size bits kept and no tile width, row length or page type; bit 19 reads as the flat marker (the same bit as tiles_per_row 32, but no geometry is set), and the buffer is addressed with 2048-byte rows. The packet pool sets page_type and tiles_per_row 1.

struct.name: EXEC_CTL
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, hardware start-up, context switch and stop-event routines
struct.doc: Starts the engine on a packet position and reports where it is. A write is the packet position (in 32-byte units from the pool base) shifted to bit 12, bit 11 and the idle count; the driver writes 2 as the idle count with every start and 0x40 with 0xfffff in the position field at start-up. A read returns the position in bits 31:12, and zero there means none, in which case the driver reads the chain register instead.

struct.name: DOORBELL
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, the routines that queue work or resume a suspended context
struct.doc: Written with a single bit from three routines. Two write it when work is appended to a non-deferred node or a timer event fires, with the current queue at 2, a node in the hardware and that node's chunk count 0. The third, which suspends a node, writes it when the node's status bits 3:1 are clear, its chunk count is below 1, status bit 9 is clear and the status byte above bit 7 is non-zero.

struct.name: INT_CAUSE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, interrupt handler, context switch and stop-event routines
struct.doc: The interrupt handler treats a read of zero as not its own, masks the value with the two cause bits, writes zero and waits for the masked bits to change. The context switch waits for bit 31 to read set and then writes every bit but 31 set.

struct.name: INT_ENABLE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, hardware start-up
struct.doc: Written once, with both cause bits set.

struct.name: SCISSOR_MIN
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, the routine that builds the window-parameter packet; the OpenGL driver's scissor packet
struct.doc: Scissor minimum corner, read into the window-parameter packet when the node already in the hardware is restarted. The window offset follows from the scissor packet's address field.

struct.name: SCISSOR_MAX
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, the routine that builds the window-parameter packet; the OpenGL driver's scissor packet
struct.doc: Scissor maximum corner, inclusive.

struct.name: CHAIN_NEXT
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, stop-event routine, and the chain packet the OpenGL driver ends a node with
struct.doc: The first word of the chain packet. The stop-event routine reads it: the low 12 bits are the high half of a 24-bit sequence number and bits 31:12 a node position, which it falls back to when the execution register reads zero.

struct.name: CHAIN_THIS
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, context switch and stop-event routines
struct.doc: The second word of the chain packet. Bits 31:12 are the position of the node the engine stopped in and bits 11:0 the low half of the sequence number. The context switch writes zero to it when the incoming node is already the one in hardware.

struct.name: TEX_ID
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, context switch, stop-event and bind routines; the OpenGL driver's texture-free packet
struct.doc: The third word of the long chain packet. The kernel driver keeps a per-context current-texture id and writes it here when it starts the context and reads it back at a stop; the OpenGL driver zeroes it before it frees the pages of the bound texture.

struct.name: CTX_DUMP
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 kernel driver, context switch
struct.doc: Written with the outgoing context's dump offset (the field the driver names as its context-switch dump offset) when another context is started, before the new context's start word.

struct.name: BLEND_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoBlendModeReg, blend writer
struct.doc: First word of the blend packet; the second is the constant colour.

struct.name: COLOR_FORMAT
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoColorFormatReg, draw-buffer descriptor writers
struct.doc: Draw-buffer descriptor.

struct.name: COLOR_TEST_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoColorTestModeReg, alpha-test writer
struct.doc: First word of the alpha-test packet; the second is the reference colour.

struct.name: DEPTH_TEST
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoDepthTestReg, depth-test writers
struct.doc: Depth test word.

struct.name: DRAW_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoDrawModeReg, pixel-pipe mode-word writers in the OpenGL driver
struct.doc: Pixel-pipe mode word.

struct.name: FB_ADDR
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoFbAddrType, scissor and clear-rectangle writers
struct.doc: A corner: x in the low half, y in the high half (signed 16-bit).

struct.name: LIGHT_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoLightModeReg, lighting-path writers
struct.doc: Lighting mode word.

struct.name: LINK_WORD
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoPktDescType, packet link-word writers in both drivers
struct.doc: Link word of a packet node. It sits in node dword 0 and the drivers write it through the second CPU window (base 0xc0000000) plus the node offset. Bit 0 set means the engine owns the node and clears it when done. The size field counts 32-byte units of data after the 32-byte header unit.

struct.name: LOGIC_OP
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoLogicOpReg, logic-operation writer
struct.doc: Logic operation word.

struct.name: PRIM_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoPrimModeReg, primitive-mode writers in the OpenGL driver
struct.doc: Primitive mode word.

struct.name: STENCIL_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoStencilModeReg, stencil writers
struct.doc: First word of the stencil packet.

struct.name: SZ_FORMAT
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoSzFormatReg, depth and stencil descriptor writers
struct.doc: Depth and stencil buffer descriptor.

struct.name: TEXENV_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoTexEnvModeReg, texture-environment writers
struct.doc: First word of the two-word texture-environment packet; the second is the environment colour.

struct.name: TEXGEN_FORMAT
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoTexGenFormatReg, texture-parameter writers in both drivers
struct.doc: First word of the four-word texture packet; the display driver's YUV blit sends 14 or 15 as the texture type.

struct.name: TEXGEN_LOD
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoTexGenLodReg
struct.doc: Third word of the texture packet; the fourth is the border colour.

struct.name: TEXGEN_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoTexGenModeReg
struct.doc: Second word of the texture packet.

struct.name: XFORM_MODE
struct.from: SGI Cobalt Graphics Driver 5.2.4 type CoXformModeReg, draw-flags writers in the OpenGL driver
struct.doc: Transform mode word , the draw flags word.
